proposed_connector.description: Malaysian Companies Commission (Suruhanjaya Syarikat Malaysia / SSM) corporate registry plus Penang Science Park tenancy directory; verifies that a named foreign-subsidiary entity is registered and tenanted at a stated address.
proposed_connector.endpoint: https://www.ssm.com.my/Pages/eservices/MyData.aspx (SSM MyData) and https://www.penangsciencepark.com.my/ (Penang Science Park tenant directory)

proposed_connector.completeness: All Malaysian-registered companies (SSM); Penang Science Park tenants only.

claims.extraction_notes: epa_frs.query_facilities is US-only and cannot adjudicate a Malaysian facility. EDGAR fulltext for 'Penang' or 'Fab2' would only retrieve Enovix's own filings, not independent confirmation. Treat as structurally UNVERIFIABLE absent the proposed connector.

claims.extraction_notes: An acquisition of this size triggers an 8-K (Item 2.01) by ENVX; presence of a contemporaneous 8-K filed around 2023-10-31 with Item 2.01 adjudicates the closing event. Korean corporate-registry (NICE / DART) confirmation would be ideal but is out of catalog scope; SEC 8-K cadence is the cleanest in-catalog adjudication.

claims.claim_text: Enovix expects that at 80% Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), each Gen2 manufacturing line will be able to produce at least 9.5 million batteries annually, depending on cell size.
claims.source_quote: We anticipate that at 80% overall equipment effectiveness ( OEE ), our Gen2 manufacturing line would be able to produce at least 9.5 million batteries annually, depending on cell size.
claims.subject: Enovix Gen2 manufacturing line
claims.object_value: ≥9.5 million batteries per Gen2 line at 80% OEE
claims.extraction_notes: Forward-looking nameplate capacity at an assumed OEE that the company has not yet achieved. No external registry observes per-line throughput; only ENVX's own future 10-Q/10-K unit-shipped disclosures could test it. Pure aspirational engineering claim — calibration heuristic 3 (planned vs operational) flags it as not currently adjudicatable.

claims.claim_text: Enovix's cell architecture with its constraint system is designed to enable silicon anodes to achieve a minimum of 500 complete charge/discharge cycles to 80% remaining capacity, with plans to sample batteries in 2024 that extend cycle life to 1,000 cycles.
claims.source_quote: with its constraint system is designed to enable silicon anodes to achieve a minimum of 500 complete charge/discharge cycles to 80% remaining capacity. We plan to sample batteries in 2024 that extend cycle life to 1,000 cycles.
claims.subject: Enovix silicon-anode cell
claims.extraction_notes: Cycle-life claims of this kind require independent test-lab data with conditions specified (rate, temperature, depth-of-discharge). Cohort heuristic notes that without those conditions the claim is an aspirational research milestone. No US federal registry observes cell-level cycle-life test results; DOE/Argonne/NREL battery-testing data could in principle but only for DOE-funded programs. Treat as structurally UNVERIFIABLE.
